meta.name: approach-evaluation
meta.description: Research industry standards and best practices, identify viable approaches for a given technical or architectural problem, and produce a structured factual comparison against project-specific constraints. Reports options — does not decide.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 比较技术方案，输出结构化分析报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个技术方案中基于约束做客观比较
copy.tagline_en: Compare technical approaches and output structured analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need objective comparison of technical approaches against project constraints

howto.what: 当遇到技术或架构决策问题时，Claude 会研究多个可行方案，收集证据，生成一份结构化对比报告，列出各方案的优缺点和折衷，但不做选择。
howto.when: 当面临有多种可选方案的技术问题、首次引入新技术或缺少相关约定时触发。已有明确约定或方案明显时不会激活。

say.text: 比较用REST和GraphQL实现API的优缺点。
say.note: 你会得到两种方案的对比报告。

say.text: 评估我们项目采用微服务架构的可行性。
say.note: 生成一份包含标准、对比和折衷的分析。

say.text: 为文件上传功能找几种可行方案。
say.note: Claude 会研究并给出选项报告。

howto.what_en: When a technical or architectural decision arises, Claude researches multiple viable approaches, gathers evidence, and produces a structured comparison report listing trade-offs without making a decision.
howto.when_en: Activated when facing a problem with multiple approaches, introducing a new technology, or lacking existing conventions. Not activated when a convention or obvious solution exists.

say_en.text: Compare REST vs GraphQL for our API.
say_en.note: You will get a structured comparison report.

say_en.text: Evaluate microservices architecture for our project.
say_en.note: Generates an analysis with criteria and trade-offs.

say_en.text: Find viable approaches for file upload feature.
say_en.note: Claude researches and outputs option report.
